tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground and every panel. There is no raised surface: panels sit on the page, set apart by rules.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: map and image wells, metric cells, row hover, loading skeletons.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines between rows and items inside a section. Decorative (1.6:1), never a control edge.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: 2px rules that open a section, control borders, the header base. 18.9:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on paper (18.9:1) and paper-2 (16.7:1). Also the 8px top bar and solid hover fills.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper (9.6:1), paper-2 (8.5:1) and blue-soft (8.1:1).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Captions, axis labels, metadata on paper (5.4:1) and paper-2 (4.8:1). Not on blue-soft below 14px.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The one hue for action and orientation: links, the primary button fill, focus ring, current item, selected ring. 7.6:1 on paper.

tokens.name: blue-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed for anything blue. Link hover.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the selected row or current page. Text on it stays ink; the selected item's name takes blue.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a blue fill (7.6:1).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Danger only: error text, the 4px rule over a danger alert, destructive buttons. 6.9:1 on paper. Always with a word.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Severity ramp step 1 (lowest, e.g. AQI Good). Always with a 1px ink edge, since it matches the page.

tokens.name: data-1-ink
tokens.usage: Text on data-1 (18.9:1).

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Severity ramp step 2 (e.g. AQI Moderate). L* 85.

tokens.name: data-2-ink
tokens.usage: Text on data-2 (12.7:1).

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Severity ramp step 3 (e.g. AQI Unhealthy for sensitive groups). L* 68.

tokens.name: data-3-ink
tokens.usage: Text on data-3 (7.6:1).

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Severity ramp step 4 (e.g. AQI Unhealthy). L* 48. Data only, never a button or alert.

tokens.name: data-4-ink
tokens.usage: Text on data-4 (4.8:1): bold 14px and up only.

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Severity ramp step 5 (e.g. AQI Very unhealthy). L* 29.

tokens.name: data-5-ink
tokens.usage: Text on data-5 (9.6:1).

tokens.name: data-6
tokens.usage: Severity ramp step 6, the end of the scale (e.g. AQI Hazardous). L* 5.

tokens.name: data-6-ink
tokens.usage: Text on data-6 (18.9:1).

tokens.name: data-line
tokens.usage: Chart lines and marks: 2px ink, dashed for forecasts.

tokens.name: data-highlight
tokens.usage: The one takeaway mark in a chart (a peak, the latest value), always direct-labelled in blue.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One statement per page: the headline that answers the page's question. Flush left, max 14 words.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The one number a view is about. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Title of the selected thing or a page section.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section titles, always under a 2px rule-strong line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Readings are model estimates on a 45 km grid.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: UI text, captions under figures, list metadata.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels over sections, fields and columns. Never more than four words.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Token names, codes and hex values only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, label to its own value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside lists and controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between items in a group; control padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gutter; between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Above major page parts.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of a page, poster spacing.

radius.note: Square. Corners are never rounded except true circles.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, fields, panels, markers, swatches.

tokens.name: radius-hair
tokens.usage: Focus outlines only, so the ring reads as a ring.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Dots and chart markers. Never on a box.

stroke.note: Rules do the work shadows do elsewhere. No shadows in this system.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Rows, items, swatch edges (with rule or ink).

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Section openers, control borders, header base (with rule-strong).

tokens.name: stroke-alert
tokens.usage: The top rule of an alert or callout.

tokens.name: stroke-bar
tokens.usage: The top bar of a page.

tokens.name: grid-max
tokens.usage: Page content width.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Columns at desktop; 4 on phones.

tokens.name: grid-gutter
tokens.usage: Column gutter at every width.
